checks.name: native-text report: fields extract with page evidence (A1, A2)
scanned/image-only report (no text layer): every text field abstains, no crash (A1, negative: image-only charts)
table-heavy report: an income-band table and a job/wage table both extract with distinct evidence (A1, A5)
historic-district / community-profile report: geography and vintage carry through as-filed (A1, A6)
mixed report: recognition does not confuse the income-band table with the job/wage table (A1, negative: recognition confusion)
every normalized non-abstained value carries page/span/region evidence, raw_value, method, and confidence (A2, A3)
application scope and proposed development scope remain distinct (A4)
a table-derived income-band field preserves its band and assumptions (A5)
displacement risk index is a contextual as-filed value, never a project prediction (A6)
applicant narrative and a generated summary are labelled and evidence-linked distinctly (A7)
two competing income-band tables abstain field by field rather than pick one (A8, negative: competing tables)
a current community value passed alongside extraction never overwrites the as-filed section (A8, negative: current-vs-filed)
a duplicate or superseded report gets its own independent envelope, never a mutation of the earlier one (A8, negative: duplicate/superseded)
a speculative job narrative without a job table never promotes a numeric job estimate (negative: speculative job narrative)
nonstandard headings abstain field by field instead of misfiring (negative: nonstandard headings)
a missing section (no community-profile header) abstains the whole section rather than guessing geography/vintage (negative: missing section)
a blank official template abstains cleanly across every field, never a crash (negative: blank template)
no known tenant: a residential section with no known-tenant table carries no fabricated known_tenant_profile field (negative: no known tenant)
